title: José Ramón Juanes García
text:
I am a PhD candidate in Economics at the University of Valencia. My research lies in the economics of education and human capital development, with a focus on teaching quality and pedagogical practices, which I study using causal-inference methods.
My current work examines how active and passive teaching practices affect student achievement — using within-student evidence from TIMSS 2023 — and how teachers’ work-related mental health relates to student outcomes.
Before returning to academia, I worked as a research analyst and risk-advisory consultant in the financial sector (EthiFinance Ratings, Deloitte).

Research interests

Economics of education & human capital
Teaching quality and pedagogical practices
Applied microeconometrics · causal inference
Public policy evaluation
